kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-aidb-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --pay-type Postpaid --vpc-id 'vpc-*******************' --vswitch-id 'vsw-**********' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAIDBCluster

parameters.help_en: The node specifications. The specifications must be available in the target region and compatible with the selected model (ModelName) and GPU type. Example: polar.pg.g8.8xlarge.gu30 (the actual specifications used by AI clusters of the same product; you must still confirm availability in the target region and compatibility with ModelName and the GPU type before calling the API). If the specifications are unavailable, the P_ILLEGAL_CUSTOM_SPEC error is returned. For custom models, you can call the DescribeAvailableModels operation to query the model list. The DBInstanceClass field in Items indicates the deployment specifications registered for the custom model. For built-in models, this field may currently return a null value and cannot be used as the sole basis for discovering specifications
parameters.help_zh: 节点规格，必须为目标地域可售、且与所选模型（ModelName）及卡型兼容的规格，例如 polar.pg.g8.8xlarge.gu30（同产品 AI 集群实际使用的规格，调用前仍需确认目标地域可售且与 ModelName、卡型兼容）。规格不可用时返回 P_ILLEGAL_CUSTOM_SPEC。自定义模型场景下可调用 DescribeAvailableModels 查询模型列表，其 Items 中的 DBInstanceClass 字段表示该自定义模型登记的部署规格；内置模型当前该字段可能返回空值，不能作为规格发现的唯一依据
parameters.name: db_node_class

parameters.help_en: The description of the cluster. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

This parameter takes effect only when the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认为false。

当参数PayType取值为Prepaid时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period. This parameter is required when the billing method is Prepaid. Specifies whether the subscription cluster is billed on a yearly or monthly basis. Valid values: 

Year: yearly.
Month: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

Year：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
Month：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required when the billing method is Prepaid.
When Period is set to Month, UsedTime must be an integer in the range of `[1-9]`.
When Period is set to Year, UsedTime must be an integer in the range of `[1-3]`
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The security group ID. This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the server may return errors such as InternalError (500). Make sure to specify this parameter. You can call the ECS DescribeSecurityGroups operation to obtain the security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全组 ID。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时服务端可能返回 InternalError（500）等错误，请务必传入。可调用 ECS DescribeSecurityGroups 获取安全组 ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.example:
apiVersion: v1
clusters: []
contexts: []
kind: Config
users: []
parameters.name: kube_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the cluster is managed by an ACK cluster
parameters.name: ack_admin

parameters.help_en: The management mode of the Kubernetes cluster
parameters.name: kube_management

parameters.help_en: The initial model capacity of the instance. The value must be a positive integer. A capacity unit of 1000 is equivalent to one L20N GPU
parameters.help_zh: 实例初始模型容量。必须为正整数，容量单位 1000 等于一张 L20N 等效卡
parameters.name: capacity

fields.help_en: The start time of the task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
fields.help_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
fields.name: begin_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
fields.help_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
fields.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The PolarDB instance ID on which the application depends
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): uses coupons.
false: does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The token is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求幂等，防止重复提交。由客户端生成，确保不同请求的值唯一；区分大小写，长度不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create a public endpoint
parameters.name: create_public_endpoint
